types.label: Belongs to taxon
types.description: Links a cultivar entity to its accepted taxon without implying that every taxon-level assertion automatically applies to the cultivar.

types.label: Same-taxon peer
types.description: Connects two cultivar entities governed under the same accepted species while preserving their separate cultivar identities.

types.label: Cross-taxon reference
types.description: Creates an explicit comparison bridge between cultivars placed in different accepted species; it does not imply synonymy or close genetic affinity.

types.label: Shared leaf morphology
types.description: Connects cultivars that share a governed leaf-morphology character while keeping whole-plant architecture independent.

types.label: Contrasting leaf morphology
types.description: Connects cultivars whose governed leaf forms provide a useful diagnostic contrast.

types.label: Shared growth habit
types.description: Connects cultivars with a materially shared whole-plant architectural pattern.

types.label: Contrasting growth habit
types.description: Connects cultivars whose whole-plant architectures are diagnostically different, independently of leaf morphology.

types.label: Shared colour character
types.description: Connects cultivars with a material shared seasonal colour character while retaining seasonal and environmental qualifications.

types.label: Shared cultivation preference
types.description: Connects cultivars whose approved cultivation guidance materially overlaps; inherited or group-level guidance remains explicitly qualified.

types.label: Diagnostic comparison
types.description: Connects cultivars selected for explicit comparative teaching or identification context. This relation supports comparison and never authenticates a specimen by itself.
